title: Meeting 17-year-old Sarah Vaughan at the Plantation
summary: Callender recalls Joe Morris's Plantation on Central and giving a young Sarah Vaughan a ride.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them

blocks.x: The Last Word. That was on Central. The Last Word was one. Then there were a couple of places across the street. Then further out on Central, Joe Morris opened a place called the Plantation, and he had big bands in there. That's when I first met Sarah Vaughan. That was back there. She was working with Billy Eckstine's band.

Was it Billy Eckstine's band? Either Billy Eckstine or Earl Hines; I'm not sure which. Anyhow, she was very young, too. And how I met her was, one day she was living in a hotel on Olympic and San Pedro -- I don't remember the name. Anyhow, she was trying to get out there, and I offered to take her. So that's my first meeting with Sarah Vaughan. She was 17 then, too.
